description:
Ultra Male by Jean Paul Gaultier is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for men. Ultra Male was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are Pear, Lavender, Mint, Bergamot and Lemon; middle notes are Cinnamon, Clary Sage and Caraway; base notes are Black Vanilla Husk, Amber, Patchouli and Cedar.

Jean Paul Gaultier launches its new fragrance Ultra Male in summer 2015. The fragrance is a reinterpretation or enhanced version of the popular original Le Male from 1995. Ultra Male, announced as masculine, intense, seductive and at the same time delicate, is supposedly built on contrasts notes and is a spicier version of the original.

It opens with citrus notes of bergamot, along with juicy pear, black lavender and mint. The heart includes spices of cumin and cinnamon, with aromatic clary sage. The base consists of black vanilla, amber and woods. It is signed by Francis Kurkdjian.

The face of the advertising campaign is model Jarrod Scott. The fragrance arrives in a characteristic torso bottle, this time colored in dark blue with black stripes. It is available as 40, 75 and 125 ml Eau de Toilette Intense.

description:
Le Male by Jean Paul Gaultier is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for men. Le Male was launched in 1995. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are Lavender, Mint, Cardamom, Bergamot and Artemisia; middle notes are Cinnamon, Orange Blossom and Caraway; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber, Sandalwood and Cedar.

Intensive and sensible, modern, and comfortably warm, masculine and gentle... Le Male is magnetically attractive fragrance which seduces with its uniqueness; it is built on contrasts: traditional and bold, fresh and mild, strong and sensual, in one word: absolutely irresistible for women. Fresh mint is a symbol of strength; the tradition is represented by lavender; vanilla gives warmth and tenderness. The top notes are composed of mint, lavender and bergamot. The heart is composed of cinnamon, cumin, and orange blossom. The base contains vanilla, tonka bean, sandalwood and cedarwood. It was created in 1995 by Francis Kurkdjian.

description:
Le Male Elixir by Jean Paul Gaultier is a Oriental Fougere fragrance for men. Le Male Elixir was launched in 2023. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. Top notes are Lavender and Mint; middle notes are Vanilla and Benzoin; base notes are Honey, Tonka Bean and Tobacco.

Welcome on board! The new sailor Le Male Elixir will induce burning cravings and drive your senses crazy. Burning desire spreads with the irresistible notes of fresh lavender, warming tonka bean, and gentle benzoin. With a gilded torso, this fiery novelty from Jean Paul Gaultier embodies radiant power and seductive charisma. It is finished! You melt away with burning desire.

This intense fragrance ignites the fire of the senses on his upper body and gives the soft skin a burning sensuality. After a refreshing breeze of mint, the tide rises to addiction, becoming a glowing elixir. In this breath of fresh air, dashing lavender quickly takes on lusty proportions, enhanced by the balsamic richness of benzoin with syrupy vanilla accents. The tonka bean trumps with its warm and sweet tones between honey and tobacco. The time has come: You jump!

Radiant at first sight, glowing with masculinity, more fiery than ever. The torso is bursting with muscles, the skin is bathed in copper color by the sinking sun. What a Gaultier body... what accomplished style. Finely chiseled grooves stand out on its muscles dipped in gold and merge with the amber stripes of the sailor shirt, which plays with transparency effects in a highly sexy way.

Available as 75ml and 125ml Parfum.

"And what love can do that dares love attempt"   William Shakespeare

The pear is still there, hidden in blooms while its cool moisture balances the edgy note of jasmine. The rose shines brightly and its whisper turns into a powerful monologue.

Top notes are Juniper, Sea Salt, Black Pepper and Mastic or Lentisque; middle notes are Solar Notes, Clary Sage, Orris and Olibanum; base notes are Sea Notes, Woodsy Notes, Ambergris, Vetiver, Ambroxan and Musk.

A Lab on Fire presents Hossegor, a spiritual, introspective, and ‘gypsoul’ fragrance that evokes meaningful instants spent embraced by the beauty of nature. This captivating new scent is a 180-degeree turn from last year’s California Snow, which was inspired by the decadence, rampant drug use, and conspicuous consumption of the young urban Hollywood. Hossegor is the brand’s latest collaboration with talented perfumer Mackenzie Reilly, who was born and raised in New York but has lived in a variety of countries, including France, Italy, Singapore, e Netherlands, and the US. Sophisticated, authentic, and almost Zen, this new scent could be described as dawning and of a masculine nature.

Describing her creation, Mackenzie Reilly said: “Hossegor was developed around the smell of water, notably while surfing in Indonesia. e concept of wet woods, sea salt, mineral notes, rocky seaside cliffs, ocean evaporating on skin, and the elusive scent of ambergris. e scent is clean, fresh, elemental, and mineral, while also being a true sensual skin-scent. A key note for the green top is Mastic, resin from a Mediterranean tree, which grows by the sea in rocky, saline environments."

Imagine getting lost as you watch the the sun rise over the deep blue sea; then walking through a pine forest to reach a completely deserted beach. e balsamic scent of pines merges with sea salt, in a mesmerising and indelible dejavu. You are alone, yet surrounded by the powerful sounds of nature, a unison of voices speaking to a place deep inside your soul. e whole universe reveals itself in the movement of the waves, whispering peaceful m

name: Crushed Velvet A.N Other
accords: warm spicy; floral; woody; metallic; amber; leather; sweet; smoky; aromatic; powdery
description:
Crushed Velvet by A.N Other is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Crushed Velvet was launched in 2024. The nose behind this fragrance is Catherine Selig. Top notes are Saffron, Amyris and Cypress; middle notes are Vanilla Orchid, Poppy, Incense and Smoke; base notes are Frankincense, Skin musk and Sandalwood.

Warmth delivered with the gentle touch of velvet. Like sweet, soft, words spoken in a whisper.

The intense notes of Saffron Blossom are hard to tame, and this makes the perfume complex. Saffron spice is a tiny vivid crimson thread, not much thicker than hair, with a spirit as wild as Daenerys Targaryen; and is as difficult to control as her dragons.

The depth comes from Frankincense. An enigmatic gum resin that traces its roots to the Bible. It lends the warmth and comfort needed to “calm” Saffron’s ardor.

“I wanted to give a sense of security that comes from a position of power. To surround the wearer with a halo of warmth and safety, like a cocoon.”

Catherine Selig

description:
Sultry Green by A.N Other is a Aromatic Green fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Sultry Green was launched in 2024. The nose behind this fragrance is Rodrigo Flores-Roux. Top notes are Pine tar, Cardamom and Cypress; middle notes are Frankincense, Coriander and Cinnamon; base notes are Patchouli, Black Leather and Akigalawood.

This perfume was created by Hall of Famer perfumer Rodrigo Flores-Roux as his magnum opus. It is anchored on frankincense, a noble raw material fit for a masterpiece.

With no brakes on the budget, Rodrigo used what he calls “the Rolls Royce ingredients of perfumery”. Premium raw materials designated by Givaudan as ‘pure gold’ – ORPUR in French. They deliver an intensified olfactive profile with remarkable longevity.

“The opportunity to work without artistic direction was a marvelous way to outdo myself and create a magnum opus.”

Rodrigo Flores-Roux

description:
Out In The Open by A13 is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. Out In The Open was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Miguel Matos. Top notes are Gardenia, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Saffron and Apple; middle notes are Mimosa, Broom, Jasmine, Orris and Orange Blossom; base notes are Beeswax, Civet, Leather, Tonka Bean, Vanilla and Sandalwood.

Out in the Open is a bold unveiling — a fragrance about stepping into the light with confidence and authenticity.

It opens with a radiant blend of gardenia, crisp apple, and soft ambrette, laced with a whisper of saffron.

At its heart, sun-drenched mimosa and jasmine bloom beside orris and orange blossom, evoking warmth and clarity.

The base reveals a sensual trail of beeswax, civet, and leather, softened by tonka bean, vanilla, and creamy sandalwood.

A scent for those unafraid to be truly seen.

description:
Behind Closed Doors by A13 is a Chypre fragrance for women and men. Behind Closed Doors was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Flavius Calaj. Top notes are Blood Orange, Pineapple, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot and Magnolia; middle notes are Cumin, Cinnamon, White Honey, Cardamom and Leather; base notes are Civet, Peru Balsam, Amber, Incense, Honey, Cedar, Pink Pepper and Vanilla.

description:
Unicorn by Aaron Terence Hughes is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Unicorn was launched in 2024. The nose behind this fragrance is Aaron Terence Hughes. The fragrance features Saffron, Oud, Raspberry, Amber, Frankincense, Incense, Bark, White Musk, Patchouli, Clove, Bergamot, Vanilla Absolute, Tonka and Cinnamon.

Unicorn by Aaron Terence Hughes is an Extrait de Parfum featuring a proprietary 'Unicorn Oud' developed specifically for the fragrance. The composition opens with bright bergamot and fruity raspberry, enriched by exotic saffron. The heart combines incense and amber with spicy cinnamon bark and clove, anchored by the signature 8% Unicorn Oud. The base reveals warm vanilla absolute and tonka absolute, layered with earthy patchouli, smoky frankincense, and clean white musk. This results in a complex oriental-spicy fragrance with slight animalic undertones and excellent longevity.

Icon by Aaron Terence Hughes is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Icon was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Aaron Terence Hughes. Top notes are Apple, Blood Mandarin and Italian Lemon; middle notes are Grapefruit, Lavender and Sea Salt; base notes are Vanilla, Sandalwood, Cedarwood and Amber.

Icon is a sophisticated unisex fragrance that leans confidently masculine, designed as a signature scent with exceptional presence and longevity. The composition opens with a bright and energetic blend of Italian lemon, blood mandarin, and crisp apple, creating an immediate sense of freshness and vitality. The heart develops into a unique aromatic combination of lavender, sea salt, and grapefruit, offering both traditional elegance and modern marine facets that add depth and complexity. The fragrance settles into a warm, creamy base of amber, cedarwood, sandalwood, and vanilla, creating a smooth and inviting dry down that maintains its character for hours. With its high concentration and carefully balanced formula, Icon delivers exceptional performance with 10-12 hours of wear and strong projection, making it suitable for both daily wear and special occasions.

KxxT by Aaron Terence Hughes is a Leather fragrance for women and men. KxxT was launched in 2023. The nose behind this fragrance is Aaron Terence Hughes. Top notes are Raspberry and Saffron; middle note is Jasmine; base notes are Smoke, Leather, Vanilla and Musk.

KxxT is described as Aaron Terence Hughes' most provocative and controversial fragrance creation. Originally conceived with explicit naming that was later changed due to public backlash, this fragrance is positioned as an adult-oriented composition that aims to evoke raw, animalistic sensuality. The fragrance combines unconventional elements like leather and raspberry with smoky, woody undertones and a jasmine backbone. It features what the creator describes as hidden animalistic musks that become more prominent with body heat. The composition is intentionally bold and polarizing, designed to make a strong statement rather than appeal to mainstream tastes.

Belle de Nuit is a rose-centric unisex fragrance designed as a sophisticated night scent with voluminous projection. The fragrance features prominent rose absolute complemented by fruity elements including raspberry, peach, and nectarine, along with Brazilian sweet orange. An iris accord adds floral depth while vanilla, tonka bean, ambergris, and sandalwood provide a warm, creamy base. The composition offers above-average projection and longevity, making it particularly suitable for evening wear.

Odyssey by Aaron Terence Hughes is a Aromatic Aquatic fragrance for women and men. Odyssey was launched in 2023. The nose behind this fragrance is Aaron Terence Hughes. Top notes are Bergamot, Mandarin Orange and Pink Grapefruit; middle notes are Ginger and Amber; base notes are White Musk, Patchouli, Cedarwood and Vetiver.

Odyssey is a fresh, citrusy aquatic fragrance that captures the essence of oceanic landscapes and Mediterranean coastlines. Designed by Aaron Terence Hughes during his time in Mexico, this composition features bright citrus opening with bergamot, pink grapefruit, and mandarin that transitions into a unique aquatic heart enhanced by seawater notes, amber, and ginger. The fragrance dries down to a woody base of cedarwood, patchouli, and vetiver balanced with white musk. The scent is described as clean, ozonic, and slightly salty, offering a modern interpretation of marine fragrances with excellent longevity and projection.

Legend Noir by Aaron Terence Hughes is a warm, spicy fragrance built around a contrast of aromatic and gourmand tones. It opens with black pepper, lavender, and assorted spices, creating a vivid, slightly sharp and aromatic first impression. A note of apple in the heart adds a crisp, fruity nuance that softens the spices without making the composition overtly sweet. The base combines vanilla, amber, and incense, giving the scent a dense, resinous and slightly smoky character with a lasting sweetness and warmth.

The heart reveals rich amber paired with creamy tonka bean, creating a luxurious and enveloping middle phase. The base is built on a sophisticated foundation of cedarwood, clove, frankincense, oakmoss, patchouli, Thai oud, vanilla, and vetiver, resulting in a deep, woody, and resinous dry down with both smoky and sweet facets.

It opens with a prominent cognac note that leads into a warm heart of honey, cinnamon and apple. The base combines chocolate, vanilla, tonka bean and sandalwood to create a dense, lingering trail. The composition focuses on blending liquor, spice, fruit and dessert-like accords into a unified, comfort-oriented scent profile.

name: Narcissus Aaron Terence Hughes
description:
Narcissus by Aaron Terence Hughes is a fragrance for women and men. Narcissus was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Aaron Terence Hughes.

"Narcissus was a hunter in Greek mythology, son of the river god Cephissus and the nymph Liriope. He was a very beautiful young man, and many fell in love with him. She led him to a pool; there, Narcissus saw his reflection in the water and fell in love with it. Although he did not realise in the beginning that it was just a reflection, when he understood it, he fell in despair that his love could not materialise and committed suicide. This is the most beautiful male fragrance. Will make all beings fall in love with you. Deeply masculine but balanced with a sweet nature. Narcissus takes you on a Cedarwood and Sandalwood journey. Moving from a Musk and wood base, through to an ozonic heart and ending with Bergamot and Fig. " - a note from th brand.

Aaron Terence Hughes Water is an aquatic-ozonic fragrance created for women and men and released as the first entry in the brand’s The Alchemist Series. The composition is deliberately minimal, built around three key accords intended to evoke the sensation of cool water and moving air in warm conditions. It opens with a clear ozone note, moves into an aquatic heart, and settles on an ice accord in the base. The fragrance was composed by British perfumer Aaron Terence Hughes, who is also the owner of the brand, and is available in a 50 ml bottle.

Its base emphasizes Thai oud, sandalwood, Haitian vetiver, and patchouli, creating a dense scent profile with smoky incense facets, creamy woods, earthy depth, and a subtle sweetness.

Onyx Air is a unisex extrait de parfum released in 2023 as part of Aaron Terence Hughes’ Oud Collection and the Onyx series. The composition contrasts airy ozonic facets with a dense, sweet‑spicy structure. It opens with ozone and rose absolute, moving into a heart of amber, fig, jasmine and a truffle note that adds gourmand and earthy nuances to the floral core. The base combines ambergris, Thai oud, vanilla and white musk with cinnamon, clove and oakmoss, forming an oriental profile that blends sweetness, florals, spice and woods. Within the broader Onyx line, Onyx Air is presented as a lighter and more lifted take on the oud‑amber theme, with a more prominent floral dimension and an emphasis on day‑to‑day versatility.

description:
Sharif by Abdes Salaam Attars Perfumes is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Sharif was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Dominique Dubrana. The fragrance features Almond, Leather, Oriental notes, Amber, Woody Notes and Civetta.

The word Sharif means «noble man» in Arabic language.

Among Arabs, nobility is not necessarily associated with lineage but is a quality that is associated first of all with the character. It is said of a person that he is noble even though not of noble descent. Nobility, for the fierce people of the desert, is a quality of the soul.

Sharif is a fragrance that attracts attention to the person who wears it, like the radiant light of a noble person’s character attracts the attention of all those present, an attraction of the soul. Sharif is the fragrance of a noble sheikh of Arabia who has chosen supreme elegance over flamboyance, gentleness over arrogance and seduction over haughtiness.

in the pure middle Eastern tradition Sharif blends intense leathery notes with aromatic woods and the delicious oriental aroma of amber, sweet and almondy.

The scent of Civet, far in the background, confers to the fragrance a sensual touch of desert wilderness, like the sillage left by a caravan of camels crossing the Bedouin lands at the sunset.

Sharif is a unisex perfume of a sophisticated elegance. A fragrance that can be worn as a social or working choice for important encounters, or for a pure enjoyment of the soul for the deep feeling of self confidence that it bestows.
